SILT#00070: ISO 1 defines the standard reference temperature for measuring geometry of products, set at 20 °C (68 °F, 293.15 K, 527.67 R). Then there is ISO 2, which standardizes the directions for twists on yarn and similar (S for left-handed twist and Z for right-handed)

- Found ISO 1
